name: Chung Tai Resource Technology Corp.
summary: CHUNGTAI RESOURCE Technology CORP. engages in waste removal and processing, and recycling of waste lighting sources and waste printed circuits in Taiwan and Japan. The company provides thermolytic treatment system, waste printed circuit board recycling, waste light resource utilization, waste removal, incineration thermal power generation and processing, and laboratory testing services. It also offers copper powder and glass granule products, as well as glass and crystal products. The company was founded in 1990 and is based in Taoyuan City, Taiwan.
